# Set Global Variable At Index

Source: [wiki article 4415](../archive/4415.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Set Global Variable At Index](../../api/actions/set-global-variable-at-index.md).

<a id="wiki-4415-n1"></a>

- Set Global Variable At Index replaces a non-array variable with an empty array, then writes; writing beyond the end extends with zero-filled elements.
